testcase.name: muzzle velocity points along the aim
drag is quoted per tick and applies the same bleed per second at any step size
damage falls off linearly to the weapon floor and never below it
sidearms stay faster than players and drop less than two units at effective range
the gravity ramp starts at zero, ends at one, and is smooth in between
a round fired flat drops, slows and records the path it actually flew
drop is invisible up close and obvious across the arena
every gun in the table is fast enough to need sweeping
a sidearm at maximum range does its floor damage, not its muzzle damage
rounds expire on time, on energy, or on overshooting their range
